== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Luke's Blaster Pistol (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (<code>2220_2169</code>, Virtual Block 2 slip 169), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201), post p644156 by Aglets, 26 August 2011: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p644156
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on Luke. During battle, opponent may not move from here. During battle, opponent may not move from here. Twice per battle, may target a character (target loses any immunity to attrition for remainder of turn) or vehicle (with maneuver) for free. Draw destiny. Target hit and forfeit -3 if destiny +2 > defense value.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB2-169-Luke_s_Blaster_Pistol-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
